f.title: Use Form FDA 3500A for mandatory adverse event and product problem reporting
f.statement: Form FDA 3500A (MedWatch) is the form for use by user facilities, importers, distributors, packers and manufacturers for MANDATORY reporting of adverse events and product problems to FDA (OMB No. 0910-0291, form version 09/2025).

rows.actor: Manufacturer (drug/biologic applicant or other responsible person) submitting mandatory reports on Form FDA 3500A
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the only contiguous wording of the form's purpose (header columns interleave in the text). Double-check: Mandatory because the form is the mandatory-reporting format; the reporting duty itself sits in FDA regulations not quoted here.

f.title: Enter dates as dd-mmm-yyyy
f.statement: For date prompts on the form, use a 2-digit day, 3-letter month abbreviation and 4-digit year (dd-mmm-yyyy), for example 01-Jan-1900.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Manufacturer (drug/biologic applicant or other responsible person) submitting mandatory reports on Form FDA 3500A

rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: 'please use' = Recommended; form-level technical instruction.

f.title: Report patient information (Section A)
f.statement: Section A captures patient information: patient identifier (in confidence), age (years, months, weeks or days) or date of birth, sex, weight (lb or kg), and race and/or ethnicity (select all that apply).

f.title: Report type of report and outcome attributed to the adverse event (Section B)
f.statement: Section B captures the type of report (adverse event and/or product problem, e.g. defects/malfunctions) and the outcome attributed to the adverse event (check all that apply): death with date of death, life-threatening, hospitalisation (initial or prolonged), required intervention to prevent permanent impairment/damage, disability or permanent damage, congenital anomaly/birth defects, other serious or important medical events; plus date of event and date of this report.

f.title: Report suspect product details (Section C)
f.statement: Section C captures up to two suspect products: product name, strength and unit, NDC # or unique ID, manufacturer/compounder name, lot #, dose or amount, frequency, route, therapy/usage start and stop dates or duration and dose-reduction date, diagnosis for use (indication), product type (drug or biologic: brand, generic or biosimilar, OTC; compounded; cosmetics; other) and expiration date.
